checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add auto-pan for existing WAVs

impact_assessment.why: autopan only applies at render time, so a trimmed or processed WAV cannot receive a moving stereo image.
impact_assessment.benefits: pan-sweep reuses the equal-power LFO on any Coda WAV with depth 0 byte-identical and bounded gains.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rate non-negative, depth 0..1, depth 0 identity, deterministic, channels bounded, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only, reuse autopan::apply_autopan; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, sweep, determinism and bounds, a CLI command reusing --autopan-rate/--autopan-depth, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add mid/side width adjustment

impact_assessment.why: width folds or widens with L/R mixing, but there is no control that adjusts the side component of a mid/side image directly.
impact_assessment.benefits: mswidth scales the side component by a factor, with 0 giving mono, 1 byte-identical, and above 1 a wider image.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: side 0..2, side 1 identity, side 0 dual mono, wider above 1, bounded output, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, mono, widening and bounds, a CLI command with --side, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV vibrato

impact_assessment.why: score vibrato exists at render time, but a finished WAV cannot receive pitch modulation without re-rendering.
impact_assessment.benefits: vibrato warps the sample timeline with a sine LFO using deterministic linear interpolation, with depth 0 byte-identical and length preserved.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rate positive, depth non-negative, depth 0 identity, interpolation bounded, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, determinism, length and bounds, a CLI command with --vib-rate/--vib-depth, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a chorus effect for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: echo is a fixed feedback delay; there is no modulated short delay mixed with the dry signal to create chorus.
impact_assessment.benefits: chorus mixes the dry WAV with an LFO-modulated delayed copy using deterministic interpolation; zero mix is byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rate positive, depth/base non-negative, mix 0..1, zero mix identity, deterministic, bounded, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, determinism, length and bounds, a CLI command with --rate/--depth/--mix style options, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a dynamics compressor for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: limit caps samples and normalize scales a whole file, but there is no tool that reduces the gain of loud passages above a threshold while leaving quiet audio untouched.
impact_assessment.benefits: compress applies a threshold and ratio per sample with a deterministic soft knee; threshold 1 or ratio 1 is byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: threshold 0..1, ratio >=1, quiet audio unchanged, loud audio attenuated, sign preserved, bounded, determinism, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, attenuation, sign preservation and determinism, a CLI command with --comp-threshold/--comp-ratio, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 450 tests green; identity, quiet preservation, loud attenuation and sign preservation pinned by byte tests

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a legato sustain transform

impact_assessment.why: augment scales durations and stretch scales timing, but neither extends each note to the next onset to create legato.
impact_assessment.benefits: sustain extends each note's duration to the next distinct onset while leaving chords and the final note intact, preserving pitch, velocity and timbre.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: notes at a shared onset keep their length, final note unchanged, no negative durations, round-trip, empty score fails; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for extension, chord handling, final note and round-trip, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.
